# EMA Multi-User and Remote Presence

## Goal
EMA should support a mode that feels closer to:
- shared workspace presence
- remote attach
- SSH-native access
- TeamViewer-like visibility/control
- multi-user collaboration
- peer-aware session/workspace participation

than to a single-user local notes app.

## Important distinction
EMA is not literally TeamViewer.
But it should borrow the useful feeling of:
- “I can see the same thing”
- “I can attach to the live thing”
- “I can work with you in the same context”
- “the session is already there; we join it”

## Core capabilities
- attach to active session/workspace
- live shared terminal/session mirroring
- multi-user presence on workstreams and spaces
- host-aware remote access
- peer/device awareness
- safe permission/approval boundaries
- recoverable session reattachment

## Best imports
- tmate / attach semantics
- Zellij / workspace semantics
- Tabby / transport convergence
- ttyd / PTY transport boundary
- Coder / workspace-control-plane separation
